verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ عِيسُوَ، ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَدُومُ.
verses.kjv: Now these [are] the generations of Esau, who [is] Edom.
verses.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.he: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ות עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֹֽום׃

verses.ar: أَخَذَ عِيسُو نِسَاءَهُ مِنْ بَنَاتِ كَنْعَانَ: عَدَا بِنْتَ إِيلُونَ ٱلْحِثِّيِّ، وَأُهُولِيبَامَةَ بِنْتَ عَنَى بِنْتِ صِبْعُونَ ٱلْحِوِّيِّ،
verses.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.web: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
verses.he: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת־נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנֹ֣ות כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת־עָדָ֗ה בַּת־אֵילֹון֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת־עֲנָ֔ה בַּת־צִבְעֹ֖ון הֽ͏ַחִוִּֽי׃

verses.ar: وَبَسْمَةَ بِنْتَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ أُخْتَ نَبَايُوتَ.
verses.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.web: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.he: וְאֶת־בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲחֹ֥ות נְבָיֹֽות׃

verses.ar: فَوَلَدَتْ عَدَا لِعِيسُو أَلِيفَازَ، وَوَلَدَتْ بَسْمَةُ رَعُوئِيلَ،
verses.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
verses.he: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־רְעוּאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: وَوَلَدَتْ أُهُولِيبَامَةُ: يَعُوشَ وَيَعْلَامَ وَقُورَحَ. هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو عِيسُو ٱلَّذِينَ وُلِدُوا لَهُ فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ.
verses.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these [are] the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.web: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.he: וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־*יעישׁ (יְע֥וּשׁ) וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־לֹ֖ו בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخَذَ عِيسُو نِسَاءَهُ وَبَنِيهِ وَبَنَاتِهِ وَجَمِيعَ نُفُوسِ بَيْتِهِ وَمَوَاشِيَهُ وَكُلَّ بَهَائِمِهِ وَكُلَّ مُقْتَنَاهُ ٱلَّذِي ٱقْتَنَى فِي أَرْضِ كَنْعَانَ، وَمَضَى إِلَى أَرْضٍ أُخْرَى مِنْ وَجْهِ يَعْقُوبَ أَخِيهِ،
verses.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.web: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.he: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־כָּל־נַפְשֹׁ֣ות בֵּיתֹו֒ וְאֶת־מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־כָּל־בְּהֶמְתֹּ֗ו וְאֵת֙ כָּל־קִנְיָנֹ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَمْلَاكَهُمَا كَانَتْ كَثِيرَةً عَلَى ٱلسُّكْنَى مَعًا، وَلَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ أَرْضُ غُرْبَتِهِمَا أَنْ تَحْمِلَهُمَا مِنْ أَجْلِ مَوَاشِيهِمَا.
verses.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.web: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
verses.he: כִּֽי־הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יֽ͏ָכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: فَسَكَنَ عِيسُو فِي جَبَلِ سَعِيرَ. وَعِيسُو هُوَ أَدُومُ.
verses.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau [is] Edom.
verses.web: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
verses.he: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֹֽום׃

verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ مَوَالِيدُ عِيسُو أَبِي أَدُومَ فِي جَبَلِ سَعِيرَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.web: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
verses.he: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ות עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱדֹ֑ום בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃

verses.ar: هَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ بَنِي عِيسُو: أَلِيفَازُ ٱبْنُ عَدَا ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو، وَرَعُوئِيلُ ٱبْنُ بَسْمَةَ ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو.
verses.kjv: These [are] the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.web: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.he: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמֹ֣ות בְּנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן־עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן־בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

verses.ar: وَكَانَ بَنُو أَلِيفَازَ: تَيْمَانَ وَأَوْمَارَ وَصَفْوًا وَجَعْثَامَ وَقَنَازَ.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.web: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.he: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אֹומָ֔ר צְפֹ֥ו וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז׃

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ تِمْنَاعُ سُرِّيَّةً لِأَلِيفَازَ بْنِ عِيسُو، فَوَلَدَتْ لِأَلِيفَازَ عَمَالِيقَ. هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو عَدَا ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو.
verses.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these [were] the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
verses.web: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.he: וְתִמְנַ֣ע ׀ הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو رَعُوئِيلَ: نَحَثُ وَزَارَحُ وَشَمَّةُ وَمِزَّةُ. هَؤُلَاءِ كَانُوا بَنِي بَسْمَةَ ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
verses.web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.he: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ كَانُوا بَنِي أُهُولِيبَامَةَ بِنْتِ عَنَى بِنْتِ صِبْعُونَ ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو، وَلَدَتْ لِعِيسُو: يَعُوشَ وَيَعْلَامَ وَقُورَحَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.web: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.he: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת־עֲנָ֛ה בַּת־צִבְעֹ֖ון אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת־*יעישׁ (יְע֥וּשׁ) וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹֽרַח׃

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ بَنِي عِيسُو: بَنُو أَلِيفَازَ بِكْرِ عِيسُو: أَمِيرُ تَيْمَانَ وَأَمِيرُ أُومَارَ وَأَمِيرُ صَفْوٍ وَأَمِيرُ قَنَازَ
verses.kjv: ¶ These [were] dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn [son] of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.web: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.he: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכֹ֣ור עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אֹומָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפֹ֖ו אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז׃

verses.ar: وَأَمِيرُ قُورَحَ وَأَمِيرُ جَعْثَامَ وَأَمِيرُ عَمَالِيقَ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ أَلِيفَازَ فِي أَرْضِ أَدُومَ. هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو عَدَا.
verses.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, [and] duke Amalek: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these [were] the sons of Adah.
verses.web: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
verses.he: אַלּֽוּף־קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱדֹ֔ום אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو رَعُوئِيلَ بْنِ عِيسُو: أَمِيرُ نَحَثَ وَأَمِيرُ زَارَحَ وَأَمِيرُ شَمَّةَ وَأَمِيرُ مِزَّةَ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ رَعُوئِيلَ فِي أَرْضِ أَدُومَ. هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو بَسْمَةَ ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Reuel in the land of Edom; these [are] the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
verses.web: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֙חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱדֹ֔ום אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو أُهُولِيبَامَةَ ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو: أَمِيرُ يَعُوشَ وَأَمِيرُ يَعْلَامَ وَأَمِيرُ قُورَحَ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ أُهُولِيبَامَةَ بِنْتِ عَنَى ٱمْرَأَةِ عِيسُو.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these [were] the dukes [that came] of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.web: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.he: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو عِيسُو ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَدُومُ، وَهَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاؤُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: These [are] the sons of Esau, who [is] Edom, and these [are] their dukes.
verses.web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
verses.he: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֹֽום׃ ס

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو سَعِيرَ ٱلْحُورِيِّ سُكَّانُ ٱلْأَرْضِ: لُوطَانُ وَشُوبَالُ وَصِبْعُونُ وَعَنَى
verses.kjv: ¶ These [are] the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.web: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.he: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי־שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לֹוטָ֥ן וְשֹׁובָ֖ל וְצִבְעֹ֥ון וַעֲנָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَدِيشُونُ وَإِيصَرُ وَدِيشَانُ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ ٱلْحُورِيِّينَ بَنُو سَعِيرَ فِي أَرْضِ أَدُومَ.
verses.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these [are] the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.web: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.he: וְדִשֹׁ֥ון וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֹֽום׃

verses.ar: وَكَانَ ٱبْنَا لُوطَانَ: حُورِيَ وَهَيْمَامَ. وَكَانَتْ تِمْنَاعُ أُخْتَ لُوطَانَ.
verses.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister [was] Timna.
verses.web: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.he: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־לֹוטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲחֹ֥ות לֹוטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو شُوبَالَ: عَلْوَانُ وَمَنَاحَةُ وَعَيْبَالُ وَشَفْوٌ وَأُونَامُ.
verses.kjv: And the children of Shobal [were] these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.web: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.he: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁובָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפֹ֖ו וְאֹונָֽם׃

verses.ar: وَهَذَانِ ٱبْنَا صِبْعُونَ: أَيَّةُ وَعَنَى. هَذَا هُوَ عَنَى ٱلَّذِي وَجَدَ ٱلْحَمَائِمَ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ إِذْ كَانَ يَرْعَى حَمِيرَ صِبْعُونَ أَبِيهِ.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this [was that] Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.web: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
verses.he: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־צִבְעֹ֖ון וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת־הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹתֹ֥ו אֶת־הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְעֹ֥ון אָבִֽיו׃

verses.ar: وَهَذَا ٱبْنُ عَنَى: دِيشُونُ. وَأُهُولِيبَامَةُ هِيَ بِنْتُ عَنَى.
verses.kjv: And the children of Anah [were] these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.web: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.he: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת־עֲנָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو دِيشَانَ: حَمْدَانُ وَأَشْبَانُ وَيِثْرَانُ وَكَرَانُ.
verses.kjv: And these [are] the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.web: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.he: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ بَنُو إِيصَرَ: بِلْهَانُ وَزَعْوَانُ وَعَقَانُ.
verses.kjv: The children of Ezer [are] these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.web: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.he: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן׃

verses.ar: هَذَانِ ٱبْنَا دِيشَانَ: عُوصٌ وَأَرَانُ.
verses.kjv: The children of Dishan [are] these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.he: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃

verses.ar: هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ ٱلْحُورِيِّينَ: أَمِيرُ لُوطَانَ وَأَمِيرُ شُوبَالَ وَأَمِيرُ صِبْعُونَ وَأَمِيرُ عَنَى
verses.kjv: These [are] the dukes [that came] of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.web: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.he: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לֹוטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שֹׁובָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְעֹ֖ון אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَأَمِيرُ دِيشُونَ وَأَمِيرُ إِيصَرَ وَأَمِيرُ دِيشَانَ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ ٱلْحُورِيِّينَ بِأُمَرَائِهِمْ فِي أَرْضِ سَعِيرَ.
verses.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.web: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.he: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר׃ פ

verses.ar: وَهَؤُلَاءِ هُمُ ٱلْمُلُوكُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكُوا فِي أَرْضِ أَدُومَ، قَبْلَمَا مَلَكَ مَلِكٌ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And these [are] the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.web: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
verses.he: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱדֹ֑ום לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

verses.ar: مَلَكَ فِي أَدُومَ بَالَعُ بْنُ بَعُورَ، وَكَانَ ٱسْمُ مَدِينَتِهِ دِنْهَابَةَ.
verses.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.
verses.web: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.he: וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱדֹ֔ום בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן־בְּעֹ֑ור וְשֵׁ֥ם עִירֹ֖ו דִּנְהָֽבָה׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ بَالَعُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ يُوبَابُ بْنُ زَارَحَ مِنْ بُصْرَةَ.
verses.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יֹובָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ يُوبَابُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ حُوشَامُ مِنْ أَرْضِ ٱلتَّيْمَانِيِّ.
verses.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת יֹובָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ حُوشَامُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ هَدَادُ بْنُ بَدَادَ ٱلَّذِي كَسَّرَ مِدْيَانَ فِي بِلَادِ مُوآبَ، وَكَانَ ٱسْمُ مَدِينَتِهِ عَوِيتَ.
verses.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Avith.
verses.web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מֹואָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִירֹ֖ו עֲוִֽית׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ هَدَادُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ سَمْلَةُ مِنْ مَسْرِيقَةَ.
verses.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ سَمْلَةُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ شَأُولُ مِنْ رَحُوبُوتِ ٱلنَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth [by] the river reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹבֹ֥ות הַנָּהָֽר׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ شَأُولُ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ بَعْلُ حَانَانَ بْنُ عَكْبُورَ.
verses.kjv: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.he: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־עַכְבֹּֽור׃

verses.ar: وَمَاتَ بَعْلُ حَانَانَ بْنُ عَكْبُورَ، فَمَلَكَ مَكَانَهُ هَدَارُ وَكَانَ ٱسْمُ مَدِينَتِهِ فَاعُوَ، وَٱسْمُ ٱمْرَأَتِهِ مَهِيطَبْئِيلُ بِنْتُ مَطْرِدَ بِنْتِ مَاءِ ذَهَبٍ.
verses.kjv: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Pau; and his wife’s name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.web: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.he: וַיָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן־עַכְבֹּור֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִירֹ֖ו פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתֹּ֤ו מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

verses.ar: وَهَذِهِ أَسْمَاءُ أُمَرَاءِ عِيسُو، حَسَبَ قَبَائِلِهِمْ وَأَمَاكِنِهِمْ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ: أَمِيرُ تِمْنَاعَ وَأَمِيرُ عَلْوَةَ وَأَمِيرُ يَتِيتَ
verses.kjv: And these [are] the names of the dukes [that came] of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.web: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.he: וְ֠אֵלֶּה שְׁמֹ֞ות אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃

verses.ar: وَأَمِيرُ أُهُولِيبَامَةَ وَأَمِيرُ إِيلَةَ وَأَمِيرُ فِينُونَ
verses.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.he: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃

verses.ar: وَأَمِيرُ قَنَازَ وَأَمِيرُ تَيْمَانَ وَأَمِيرُ مِبْصَارَ
verses.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.he: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃

verses.ar: وَأَمِيرُ مَجْدِيئِيلَ وَأَمِيرُ عِيرَامَ. هَؤُلَاءِ أُمَرَاءُ أَدُومَ حَسَبَ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ فِي أَرْضِ مُلْكِهِمْ. هَذَا هُوَ عِيسُو أَبُو أَدُومَ.
verses.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these [be] the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he [is] Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
verses.he: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה ׀ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱדֹ֗ום לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֹֽום׃ פ
